ngan 'gro'i lam ni ldog sogs nas/phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs chos sogs nas/skyabs su mcha

tei:div.tei:p: sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs chos sogs nas/ skyabs su mchi/ sa gzhi byin rlabs bya/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can= chos rnams kun gyi sogs/ gshegs su gsol/ rol bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs/ la ye st+wam/ rin chen sems de sogs nas/ legs par mchod/ rang gzhan sems sogs/ oṃ badzra bhu mi sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rin chen maṇḍal= stong gsum 'jig rten= bdag gzhan dus gsum= hrīḥ rin chen lus sems= sku gsum yongs rdzogs= srid pa thams cad du yang = me tog 'bras bu sogs nas/ nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig ༈ rnam dag sku lnga= dkon mchog gsum la= skyes bu khyu mchog= thub bstod/ mgon po thugs rje= dus gsum gshegs pa'i sogs/ slan chad bdag ni yong mi bgyid/ u hu hu lags/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs/ lan gsum/ rtag par bla ma la skyabs su= sems can kun gyi ngan song sogs nas/ nyer 'tshe'i rgyur yang shog ston mchog lha mi'i sogs nas/ byin gyis rlobs/ maṇḍal/ byang chub sems bskyed kyi yongs su bzung ba'i sdom pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba sogs/ ma nam mkha' dang lan gsum/ phyogs bcu na bzhags pa'i sangs rgyas dang = byang chub snying po sogs nas/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ lan gsum/ de ltar blo dang sogs nas/ dga' bar gyis/ maṇḍal/ byang chub sems bskyed kyi sdom pa zab mo thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che sogs/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral= byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi= sems can thams cad bde dang = de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ a mo gha shi la= bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshul khrims= khrims kyi tshul khrims= gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong la goms= rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob=
rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs= sogs nas/ bla med byang chub reg gyur cig// /
